title: GHC / MLF compiler shape classification benchmark
purpose: Compile identical generated shared-Haskell programs with GHC and with GHC-hosted MLF, from fresh targets to native executables. This classifies compiler behaviour by program shape; it is not the C/MLF Benchmarks Game comparison in tools/bench.

flat_functions.label: Independent annotated functions
flat_functions.work: n annotated top-level functions summed in a balanced tree

inferred_functions.label: Independent inferred functions
inferred_functions.work: the flat_functions family with no signatures on the n generated functions

inferred_poly_functions.label: Independent inferred polymorphic functions
inferred_poly_functions.work: n unsigned independent identity/constant/application/composition functions, each used at Int and Bool with runtime-dependent branches

dependency_chain.label: Annotated dependency chain
dependency_chain.work: n annotated functions in a strict chain

inferred_chain.label: Inferred dependency chain
inferred_chain.work: the same chain with no signature on the generated functions

inferred_poly_chain.label: Inferred polymorphic dependency chain
inferred_poly_chain.work: n unsigned functions; each layer calls its predecessor and applies a supplied step once; the whole chain is used at Int and Bool

recursive_ring.label: Mutually recursive ring
recursive_ring.work: n functions in a mutually recursive cycle

poly_calls.label: Polymorphic Box calls
poly_calls.work: the same calls through a rank-1 forall

tree_chain.label: Skewed constructor tree
tree_chain.work: n leaves in a left-deep constructor tree

balanced_tree.label: Balanced constructor tree
balanced_tree.work: the same leaves in a balanced constructor tree

literal_table.label: Generated literal table
literal_table.work: a generated constructor table of n items

local_functions.label: Local let-bound functions
local_functions.work: flat functions placed inside one local let

wide_case.label: Wide constructor dispatch
wide_case.work: a runtime decision selects one of n constructors, followed by a single exhaustive n-arm case

class_instances.label: Typeclass instance selection
class_instances.work: one constrained method wrapper used at n distinct concrete types with separate instances

dependency_diamonds.label: Reconvergent dependency graph
dependency_diamonds.work: n top-level diamonds with two branches that depend on the same previous layer

state_updates.label: Ordered IO updates
state_updates.work: n unrolled pairs of reads and writes to a runtime-initialized integer array

captured_closures.label: Escaping closures
captured_closures.work: n escaping functions with captured runtime values

wide_product.label: Wide product
wide_product.work: one constructor with n integer fields and a pattern that consumes every field

rank2_arguments.label: Rank-2 function arguments
rank2_arguments.work: n rank-2 call sites passing a polymorphic argument that the consumer uses at Bool and Int

irregular_literal_table.label: Irregular literal table
irregular_literal_table.work: n two-field rows with irregular payloads consumed by an order-sensitive checksum

nested_poly_types.label: Nested polymorphic types
nested_poly_types.work: n nested polymorphic Box constructors followed by n projections

rank2_callbacks.label: Many rank-2 callback consumers
rank2_callbacks.work: n distinct consumers use their polymorphic callback at both Int and Bool

decoder_pipeline.label: Dependent decoder stages
decoder_pipeline.work: n field reads with state-dependent checks and an early malformed-input exit

recursive_lookup_workers.label: Distinct recursive tree lookups
recursive_lookup_workers.work: n independently bound recursive binary-search workers, each called on an offset runtime key

stable_recursive_workers.label: Stable recursive workers
stable_recursive_workers.work: n reachable recursive functions beside a fully applied 24-argument lambda reduced over successive optimizer passes

escaping_curried_jobs.label: Stored curried functions
escaping_curried_jobs.work: n distinct twelve-argument functions stored in a job list and partially applied and reused with two suffixes

captured_application_spines.label: Applications of a captured function
captured_application_spines.work: n calls through a function field with twelve ordered lazy arguments

curried_environment_prefix.label: Curried environment prefix
curried_environment_prefix.work: n distinct boxed arguments forwarded through a reusable partial closure

polymorphic_fanout.label: Polymorphic application fan-out
polymorphic_fanout.work: one inferred binding with n applications of a shared callback and value through a polymorphic helper, called at Int and Bool

polymorphic_box_fanout.label: Polymorphic boxed application fan-out
polymorphic_box_fanout.work: one inferred binding with n instantiations of a polymorphic boxed combinator on a shared boxed argument and callback, called at Int and Bool

polymorphic_import_fanout.label: Polymorphic predecessor imports
polymorphic_import_fanout.work: one inferred declaration depends on n separately inferred polymorphic identity functions and adds their results

inferred_dictionary_prefix.label: Inferred dictionary arguments in recursion
inferred_dictionary_prefix.work: one inferred local helper calls its enclosing recursive function and receives n overloaded string literals from distinct case arms

polymorphic_scanner_cases.label: Polymorphic scanner dispatch
polymorphic_scanner_cases.work: two mutually recursive inferred scanner functions and n branches that use one captured token handler

mixed_parser_recursion.label: Mixed-signature parser recursion
mixed_parser_recursion.work: n explicitly typed parser rules alternate with n inferred continuations in one recursive group, composing stateful parser operations at each step

polymorphic_tree_fold.label: Inferred polymorphic tree folds
polymorphic_tree_fold.work: one inferred binding with n calls to a polymorphic recursive tree fold through a two-leaf wrapper

deferred_constructor_spine.label: Deferred constructor spine
deferred_constructor_spine.work: n nested constructor demands on a chain built lazily from runtime input, including a one-node-short branch

shared_callback_let_chain.label: Shared callback let chain
shared_callback_let_chain.work: n nested shared callbacks capture the preceding value twice and are called with an outer variable or a computed operand

queued_callback_let_chain.label: Queued callback let chain
queued_callback_let_chain.work: n nested callbacks capture the preceding value once and permit delayed substitution into calls

inferred_monadic_recursion.label: Inferred monadic recursion
inferred_monadic_recursion.work: an explicitly typed recursive peer calls an inferred monadic helper with n bind and pure operations

class_declaration_reservations.label: Class declaration name reservation
class_declaration_reservations.work: n independent signed declarations with a shared name prefix, each using the same concrete class instance

datatype_validation_fanout.label: Shared datatype validation
datatype_validation_fanout.work: n independent signed functions match distinct constructors of one shared datatype

shared_datatype_fragments.label: Datatype references across fragments
shared_datatype_fragments.work: n independently checked functions each use the same n-constructor datatype and their own unary datatype

boxed_closure_factory.label: Boxed closure factory
boxed_closure_factory.work: n calls allocate closures with two captures through the same constructor worker

delayed_packet_fanout.label: Delayed packet fan-out
delayed_packet_fanout.work: n consumers inspect a shared packet, force its left field and conditionally force its right field

captured_thunk_fanout.label: Captured thunk fan-out
captured_thunk_fanout.work: n rows each contain four suspended fields that capture one through four operands

repeated_ground_dictionary_demands.label: Repeated ground dictionary demands
repeated_ground_dictionary_demands.work: a recursive predecessor exports n string literal demands at the same concrete type and two local branches use it

local_dictionary_branch_fanout.label: Local dictionary branch fan-out
local_dictionary_branch_fanout.work: n inferred local helpers each use the previous helper in two branches, with two overloaded string literals at the base

checked_constructor_dispatch.label: Checked constructor dispatch
checked_constructor_dispatch.work: n functions each inspect a product and the always-boxed two-constructor result of a runtime callback

signed_constructor_cases.label: Signed polymorphic constructor cases
signed_constructor_cases.work: n explicitly quantified declarations inspect a recursive datatype and pass the selected field to their predecessor

baseline.label: Minimal IO baseline
baseline.work: a program that only reads argv and prints it

default.description: 25 families at five sizes with one shared baseline and two pairs per cell

crate-bootstrap-v1.summary: GHC-hosted shared-source bootstrap crate producer: --compile-crate (source to checked) then --crate-to-llvm-gc (checked to LLVM), then ordinary Clang -O2. This is NOT the installed emlf SOURCE -o driver.
crate-bootstrap-v1.driver: PRODUCER/bin/emlf --compile-crate SPEC -o UNIT; PRODUCER/bin/emlf --crate-to-llvm-gc UNIT.mlfci; clang -O2 UNIT.ll
crate-bootstrap-v1.cache_boundary: each leg gets a private, empty query cache directory that is inventoried and deleted after correctness checks; no target objects, .hi/.o files, LLVM or executables are reused between legs

crate-fused-v1.summary: GHC-hosted single-invocation checked crate to LLVM; publishes the same checked object and query cache, then links the retained checked root. Separate from the two-process crate-bootstrap-v1 endpoint.
crate-fused-v1.cache_boundary: each leg gets a private, empty query cache directory that is inventoried and deleted after correctness checks; no target objects, .hi/.o files, LLVM or executables are reused between legs

emlf-source-v1.summary: Installed default emlf SOURCE -o OUTPUT driver with its native standard library. Different internal work from crate-bootstrap-v1 and therefore a separate cohort dimension.
emlf-source-v1.requires: a qualified native installation (tools/shared/build.py without --bootstrap-only) plus its own preparation step
emlf-source-v1.rule: cohorts of this endpoint must never be pooled, compared or relabelled against crate-bootstrap-v1 cohorts

claim_limits: Two pairs per cell provide quick feedback. Per-cell spread describes the observed runs on one machine.
Each comparison applies to the measured fixtures and sizes on that machine.
Different cohorts are separate windows and are never pooled into one median.
